title: Understanding the Plot
text: The plot shows a U-shaped curve as the value of $$d$$ increases. This suggests that the y-axis could represent a measure that decreases to a minimum and then increases again.

title: Possible Y-Axis Labels
text: Consider what measures in machine learning might have a U-shaped relationship with the number of features or complexity. Common examples include error rates, bias, variance, or a combination of these.

title: Identifying the Y-Axis
text: Given the U-shaped curve, which of the following could the y-axis represent? Select all that apply: 1) Training error, 2) Test error, 3) Model complexity, 4) Variance.
